description: Meridian Pacific Group has submitted their monthly order and requires a formal sales quotation and invoice. Log into Odoo (admin@example.com / admin, database: odoo_demo) and perform the following: (1) Create a new sales quotation for the customer 'Meridian Pacific Group'. Add two product lines: 15 units of 'Standing Desk Pro - Height Adjustable' and 8 units of 'Executive High-Back Chair'. Set the payment terms to '30 days' (or '30 Days' as it appears in Odoo). Add an internal note on the order: 'Priority order — expedite shipping'. (2) Confirm the quotation to generate a sales order. (3) Create an invoice from the confirmed sales order. (4) Post (validate) the invoice. (5) Register a full payment for the invoice amount.
